config.source:
SELECT
  p.*,
  e.course_level AS enrol_course_level,
  e.broad_primary_field_of_education AS enrol_field_of_education,
  e.international_domestic_student AS enrol_origin,
  e.age_band AS enrol_age_band,
  e.commencing_continuing AS enrol_commencing_continuing,
  e.student_gender AS enrol_gender
FROM workspace.student_aggregate.student_attrition_risk_prediction p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    t.student_deidentified_hash,
    c.course_level,
    c.broad_primary_field_of_education,
    t.international_domestic_student,
    t.age_band,
    t.commencing_continuing,
    t.student_gender
  FROM (
    SELECT
      e.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.student_deidentified_hash ORDER BY e.census_date DESC, e.enrolment_year DESC) AS rn
    FROM workspace.student_aggregate.rpt_student_management__fact__all_enrolment_eftsl__deidentified e
  ) t
  LEFT JOIN workspace.student_aggregate.dwh_curriculum__course c ON t.course_key_hash = c.course_key_hash
  WHERE t.rn = 1
) e ON p.student_deidentified_hash = e.student_deidentified_hash

dimensions.name: risk_level
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage >= 50 THEN 'At Risk'
  ELSE 'Not At Risk'
END

dimensions.name: risk_score_bucket
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 46 THEN '0-46%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 48 THEN '46-48%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 49 THEN '48-49%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 50 THEN '49-50%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 51 THEN '50-51%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 52 THEN '51-52%'
  WHEN source.attrition_risk_percentage < 54 THEN '52-54%'
  ELSE '54-100%'
END

SELECT
  student_deidentified_hash,
  curriculum_item_title,
  curriculum_item_type,
  study_mode,
  attendance_mode,
  study_area_b_key,
  course_key,
  course_key_hash,
  student_gender,
  age_band,
  international_domestic_student,
  socioeconomic_status,
  student_is_first_nations_student,
  student_home_language,
  citizenship_country,
  student_birth_country,
  commencing_continuing,
  enrolment_year,
  status,
  stage
FROM (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.student_deidentified_hash ORDER BY e.census_date DESC, e.enrolment_year DESC) as rn
  FROM workspace.student_aggregate.rpt_student_management__fact__all_enrolment_eftsl__deidentified e
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1

# Overview

Distribution of students across risk categories and score ranges

How to read this dashboard


Each student is placed in one of two risk categories by their attrition risk percentage. At Risk (dark blue, #1565C0): 50% or higher. Not At Risk (light blue, #42A5F5): below 50%.

The same colours and order (At Risk, then Not At Risk) are used on every chart. Score ranges run from lowest to highest.

Number of students in each attrition risk score range, lowest to highest; ranges from 50% are At Risk

lines:
### How to filter and drill down

 

**Filters**: open the Global filters panel to narrow every page at once by risk level, course level, field of education, origin, age band or commencing/continuing. Selected values combine, and every counter, chart and table updates. **Student List**: the table in the Student List page can be independently narrowed down using the filters on that page. Note that global filters still affect the Student List page. **Focus a page**: click a bar to narrow the other charts and the table on the same page. Your selections show in the active filter bar along the top of the screen where you can remove them. **Students in this view**: each analysis page lists the matching students by Student ID (de-identified), highest risk first, up to 100,000 students. Narrow the view to see others, or find any student by ID on Student List.
